meta.title: Improve pooled buffer security
meta.body_summary: Zero pooled Bytes only up to its written region instead of full buffer; clarify buffer reuse guidance in documentation.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI Codex proposed zeroing pool buffers up to write position; maintainer closed citing performance impact without benchmark.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 24 changed lines, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume, touching core buffer and pool classes plus a doc update. As a micro performance PR it was closed—not merged—because the maintainer perceived it would regress performance.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer peter-lawrey closed the PR with the comment 'this would have a performance impact', indicating the zeroing change would negatively affect performance without evidence of benefit.
review_details.performance_claim: Zeroing pooled buffers only up to the written region (instead of the whole buffer) for improved security and possible reduced memory writes.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by maintainer with explicit performance impact concern; no benchmark or data to counter.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Low-level buffer zeroing optimization in a performance-critical library; agent submitted a code change without benchmark, and the maintainer closed it citing performance degradation risk.

detection_detail.code_reading: peter-lawrey reviewed the change in BytesInternal.java and BytesPool.java, commenting that zeroing up to write position would have a performance impact.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after timing data, no benchmark, no test results; PR body mentions mvn verify but notes command not found.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Maintainer closed the PR without merge after stating it would degrade performance.

core_change_summary.description: In BytesInternal.java, add a method to zero bytes from the buffer up to the write position; in BytesPool.java, call this zeroing upon buffer release; update api-guide.adoc with reuse guidance. The change limits zeroing to the actually written portion instead of potentially the whole buffer.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Documentation update clarifies buffer reuse guidance.
change_trajectory: Single commit (a6565e9ec): zero pooled buffers up to write position.
Maintainer closed PR ~1 hour later citing performance impact.

review_signals.summary: Commented 'this would have a performance impact' and immediately closed the PR.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by peter-lawrey (codex-authored) with a single commit.
No review activity; maintainer commented and closed PR within ~58 minutes.
